§01 · The oreMetalDesk · Modernization review

The shared library nobody used

Copying a class was cheaper than depending on it, so every service forked the domain. Changed lines against the original:

LocalizedField admin
27
User admin
23
Product pricing
11
Item api
10
Constants api
9
Product admin
8
Order admin
6
Order api
5

Three different Product shapes wrote to the same Mongo collection.

FIX

The fix is structural

  • One build graph. Depending on the library costs the same keystrokes as copying it.
  • Enforced in CI, not review. ArchUnit fails the build if a domain type exists outside libs/share.
  • Toolchain parity first. One Java version everywhere, so no consumer is locked out of the library's idioms.

A monorepo only makes the drift visible. The enforcement is what stops it.

§02 · The recastMetalDesk · Modernization review

Six decisions on record

Every structural choice is an ADR in docs/adr/. These are not to be relitigated without a new record.

ADR·0001

Monorepo, day one

One Gradle graph for 8 JVM modules, a pnpm workspace for 2 SPAs. Not Bazel, and no git submodules.

ADR·0002

Mock at the boundary

WireMock or in-process fakes for payments, mail and market data. No sandbox key is ever committed.

ADR·0003

GCP target

Cloud Run, Cloud Storage + CDN, Atlas over Private Service Connect, Terraform. The AWS stack is not carried over.

ADR·0004

Java 25 · Boot 4

A uniform runtime. WebFlux for api and pricing-bridge; MVC on virtual threads for admin.

ADR·0005

One React stack

Vaadin is retired. admin becomes a pure API, and admin-web and web share React 19, TS and Vite.

ADR·0006

Staff login · Mongock

Staff get their own users and JWT, with no IAP. Migrations are Mongock change units, run at startup under a DB lock.

§02 · The recastMetalDesk · Modernization review

One domain, one formula

Everything in libs/share is free of Spring, and the reserved type names cannot exist anywhere else.

I

Price finality

OrderLine snapshots unit price and tax category when the order is made. A later margin or tax change never moves a historical total (BR-2).

II

Tiers are data

FulfillmentTier is configured by staff and evaluated by one pure TierSelector. The cheapest qualifying tier wins; ties go to the faster tier, then the lower id.

III

No raw card data

PaymentRecord holds only a provider reference. "We never store card data" is guaranteed by the data model, not just by policy.

PriceDerivation · BR-3

One formula, so api and pricing-bridge cannot disagree.

price = ref/g × (grams × fineness ÷ 1000) × (1 + margin)
fine-weight basis · rounded once at the end

§02 · The recastMetalDesk · Modernization review

The order, as a state machine

The manager handoff is a first-class state, not a side channel, so every order has a consistent status in history.

Created
Awaiting payment
Paid
Fulfilling
Shipped
Delivered ■
Awaiting manager quote
Cancelled ■

◆ A single failed payment is a PAYMENT_FAILED event. The order stays payable and the customer retries.

◆ Keyed on (status, trigger), so the three ways into CANCELLED stay distinguishable. ■ marks a terminal state.

◆ Both paths are covered end to end: CheckoutSelfServiceE2eTest and CheckoutHandoffE2eTest.

§03 · CheckoutMetalDesk · Modernization review

Two tokens that never cross

Customers sign in to api and staff sign in to admin. Separate issuer, audience and key, with cross-rejection tests guarding the line.

Customer · services/apiStaff · apps/admin
Audiencemetal-desk-storefrontmetal-desk-staff
Principalcustomers + credentialsusers: BCrypt hash, role ADMIN or MANAGER
Lifetime30 min HS256, renewed by /auth/refresh while the user is active. The idle timeout is the session.
EdgePublic, with a default-deny route allowlistNo IAP. Internal-LB ingress, plus a Cloud Armor allow list on admin-web
WHY

Stateless JWT means api scales horizontally with no session store. Password hashing runs off the event loop.

IAP

IAP can't front a CDN backend bucket, so T-076 was dropped. IapHeadersIgnoredTest proves forged headers authenticate no one.

DB

Mongock migrations run at startup in both services. The first one seeds admin/admin and manager/manager, for development only.

§04 · AssayMetalDesk · Modernization review

Gates that fail the build

Applied once from build-logic convention plugins to all 8 JVM modules. No module carries its own copy.

01

Checkstyle

maxWarnings = 0, so every violation fails. Mandatory Javadoc, with no System.out or printStackTrace. Kept in step with Google Java Format.

02

SpotBugs

Effort MAX at confidence LOW. The exclude file is empty, so any finding fails.

03

PMD

Every Java ruleset. Conflicting rules are excluded centrally with a reason, never by a @SuppressWarnings.

04

ArchUnit

DomainBoundaryTest is compiled into every module's tests. Domain types live only in libs/share.

05

Real Mongo

Testcontainers through SharedMongo, one container per JVM. AdminClasspathTest keeps WebFlux out of admin.

GAP

Jacoco

Reports are produced, but no coverage threshold is wired. Coverage could be 0% and build would still pass.

build-logic/ · metaldesk.quality-conventions
§04 · AssayMetalDesk · Modernization review

CI builds only what changed

Phase 4 exit, shown on real PRs: a PR touching only apps/web runs no JVM build, and a PR touching libs/share rebuilds every module downstream of it.

Required checks on master
✓ JVM buildAggregates the per-module matrix; passes when it was skipped
✓ Frontend build resultPer-app filter, derived from the pnpm workspace
✓ Scan for committed secretsRun on every PR from day one
✓ Scan dependenciesOSV over the CycloneDX SBOM; fails at CVSS ≥ 7.0
CACHE

The Gradle build cache and configuration cache are on. In CI the cache is persisted through the Actions cache and written only from master.

OSV

An advisory is suppressed only with a reason and an ignoreUntil at most 90 days out, enforced by osv-gate.mjs.

CD

image.yml, deploy.yml and frontend-deploy.yml authenticate through Workload Identity Federation, with no SA keys, and deploy from master only.

.github/workflows · T-060 – T-065, T-077
§04 · AssayMetalDesk · Modernization review

GCP, written as Terraform

Thin dev, staging and prod roots in strict parity, with the logic in modules/. Each name is metaldesk-<env>-<resource>.

ComponentRuns on
api · pricing-bridge · adminCloud Run; one reusable module, images pinned by SHA
web · admin-webCloud Storage + HTTPS LB + Cloud CDN
Document storeMongoDB Atlas via Private Service Connect
ImagesArtifact Registry, immutable tags, never latest
SecretsSecret Manager; Terraform creates the containers, never the values
ObservabilityCloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Actuator
STATUS

Authored, not proven

The roots validate offline and the liveness probes are in place, but no terraform apply has run. Phase 5 is not counted as met until that evidence exists.

GUARD

CI runs fmt, the env-parity check, validate and tflint, and it never applies. Only the T-078 flow applies, and it sets a budget first.

§05 · SurfaceMetalDesk · Modernization review

From product to cart

/catalog/products/prod-gold-bar-1oz

Stock is a label, not just a colour. An on-request product shows no price and offers an inquiry instead. Specs and tax treatment come from libs/share.

/cart

Prices are derived on every read. A cart can't go stale; the price is frozen only when the order snapshots its lines. An anonymous cart merges into the customer's at sign-in.

§06 · YieldMetalDesk · Modernization review

Known gaps

The docs already state each of these. None of them is hidden, and each one has to be closed before production.

INFRA

Never applied

No environment has been stood up yet. Branch protection on master is still a manual settings step.

AUTH

Throttle per instance

Sign-in throttling uses an in-memory counter, which is weak once scaled out. There are no refresh tokens and no revocation.

AUTH

Roles unenforced

ADMIN and MANAGER are carried in the staff token, but no endpoint checks them yet. The dev users are still seeded.

CLIENT

Token in localStorage

Tokens survive a reload, but an XSS flaw could read them. The 30-minute idle timeout bounds the damage.

DATA

Fake feeds

Market data and FX rates are fakes (FX is labelled FAKE in the UI). pricing-bridge keeps its prices in memory only.

QA

No coverage floor

Jacoco reports are produced but nothing fails on them, so tests can regress silently.
